video_title: Tacko Fall on Reuniting with Jaylen Brown and Return to NBA | Exclusive Interview

quotes.speaker: Tacko Fall
quotes.summary_phrase: Tacko Fall on the chemistry of his current teammates
quotes.excerpt: Tension really depends on the people you have around and they make it easy to be around.
quotes.quote: Tension really depends on the people you have around and they make it easy to be around. You have Jaylen Brown and obviously Jayson Tatum. I have known Jaylen Brown for a long time. Tyrese Maxey is a young guy, a young superstar, but great people. The chemistry on this team is great and for me it has been a really great experience.

quotes.speaker: Tacko Fall
quotes.summary_phrase: Tacko Fall on his close friendship with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is like family, so just talk about life, we joke around each other.
quotes.quote: We were together in Morocco literally right before he got traded, but when we are together we do not really talk about basketball. Jaylen Brown is like family, so just talk about life, we joke around each other. I get on him, he gets on me, but that is really it.

quotes.speaker: Tacko Fall
quotes.summary_phrase: Tacko Fall on Jaylen Brown's professional approach to the game
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is a pro all throughout. He is the same person every day.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is a pro all throughout. He is the same person every day. He comes in and works hard and the same person that you see today is the same person that you will see tomorrow regardless of where he is. He is a competitor and he is a great human being.

quotes.speaker: Tacko Fall
quotes.summary_phrase: Tacko Fall on his personal growth and overcoming career challenges
quotes.excerpt: I have had a lot of years to grow and get better. Obviously that comes with the experience.
quotes.quote: I have had a lot of years to grow and get better. Obviously that comes with the experience. Being overseas, you hold more responsibilities, so it is either a sink or swim scenario and for me I had to learn how to swim. There were a few ups and downs, some injuries along the way, but I have been able to overcome that and just really work on my body and figure out where my weaknesses were and really harp on those things.

quotes.speaker: Tacko Fall
quotes.summary_phrase: Tacko Fall on the deep personal bond with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: We share the same faith and as we got to hang out we really saw those similarities.
quotes.quote: We are very much alike in a lot of ways. He is a deep thinker, I am. He is a great person to be around. We share the same faith and as we got to hang out we really saw those similarities in each other and we kind of complement each other in a lot of ways. Jaylen Brown sometimes may be a little reserved and I am such an easygoing, always smiling and positive guy that I try to get that out of him a little bit.
